train_vae: train a VAE model on MSA data using homolog sequences and architecture hyperparameters
save_vae_model: save a trained VAE model weights and metadata to a specified disk path
load_vae_model: load a previously saved VAE model and its homolog configuration from disk
compute_likelihood_scores: compute likelihood scores of aligned sequences under a trained VAE model
fit_vae_on_msa: fit a variational autoencoder on multiple sequence alignment parent and homolog data
